name: Get App Parameters
description: Return the connected Dify app's configuration: its `user_input_form` (the exact input variable names, types, and which are required), file-upload limits, opening statement, and suggested questions. Call this before **Run Workflow** to know what to pass in its `Inputs` parameter, instead of guessing variable names. Example: an app with one required text variable returns `{ user_input_form: [{ "text-input": { variable: "city", label: "City", required: true, default: "" } }], opening_statement, suggested_questions, file_upload, ... }`, so pass `{ "city": "..." }` as `Inputs`. [See the documentation](https://docs.dify.ai/en/api-reference/applications/get-app-parameters)
